entries.title: Jeremiah 41:1
segments:
CHAP. XLI. 
 
  Ishmael, under a colour of friendship kills Gedaliah and others,   both Jews and Chaldeans, ver. 1-9.   He purposes to carry the residue captive to the Ammonites, but they   are rescued from him by Johanan, who intends to flee into Egypt,   ver. 10-18. 
 
  V. 1. Now-Three months after the city was taken.  Ishmael-The same Ishmael that came to Gedaliah, ver.

, to whom he sware protection; only here we are told he was of the royal blood, which might both raise his spirits, as having a more legal pretence to the government, and rendered him a fitter instrument, for Baalis the king or queen of the Ammonites to make use of.  The princes-Some of the princes, who had escaped the army of the king of Babylon.

entries.title: Jeremiah 41:3
segments: V. 3. Slew-All those who were about the court of Gedaliah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 41:4
segments: V. 4. No man-No man who lived at any distance from Mizpah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 41:5
segments: V. 5. There came men-Who possibly had not heard of the temple being burnt.  Cut themselves-With all indications of mourning used in those countries.

entries.title: Jeremiah 41:8
segments: V. 8. He forebare-His covetousness prevailed over his cruelty.
